title: Nixon Jerez Lillo

Nixon Jerez Lillo

Assistant Professor · Departamento de Matemática · UTFSM


 Scholar
ORCID
 GitHub


I am an Assistant Professor in the Departamento de Matemática at Universidad Técnica Federico Santa María (UTFSM) since March 2026. My research focused on survival analysis and piecewise models with change point detection.
I am always open to new collaborations! Feel free to write me an email.
